origin: A generateContent request of a Gemini client, authored from the documented shapes with placeholder ids (no capture, and not a copy of what any release of the Gemini CLI sends): a call that was never answered (the client went on, and the model called the function again), and the answers carry no ids, so the answer is the new call's. The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
